segments.t: In the final scene of the episode, Timofey apologizes to Kostya and Nastya before heading out on a real date with Anzhelika, and Lyova confesses to Chef Barinov that his own blindfold was slightly see-through. Meanwhile, Katya admits to Denis that she still has not told Nikita the truth because he flew away on a business trip!

Интересно, и за что ты извиняешься?
Во время спора я чуть-чуть видел.
Моя повязка была немного совсем прозрачная.
Мне очень стыдно, что я обманул.
